english.title: Administer poison with intent to endanger life / inflict grievous bodily harm
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), unlawfully and maliciously

(A)_[administered to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[caused to be administered to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(C)_[caused to be taken by **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_

a poison or other destructive or noxious thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SUBSTANCE..), so as thereby to endanger the life of or inflict grievous bodily harm on the said **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) See also Standard Offence Wording document H5811 and H2002.
(ii) Where this offence is committed against an emergency worker this must be treated as an aggravating factor in sentencing, see section 67 of the Sentencing Act 2020.
(iii) Terrorist connection - this offence is listed in Schedule 1 to the Sentencing Act 2020. Where the court has determined that there is a terrorist connection, the court has to treat this as an aggravating factor in sentencing (section 69 of that Act) and the notification requirements under the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008 apply (section 42 of that Act). In addition, section 23A of the Terrorism Act 2000 provides for forfeiture of money or other property.
(iv) See section 72 of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 regarding the committing of this offence outside the UK by a UK national or a person habitually resident in England and Wales.
